job.title: Digital Marketeer @ lead on (Erpe-Mere, VLG, BE)
job.description:
Lead On is een digitaal marketing agency voor klanten en medewerkers die hun groei serieus nemen. We combineren strategie met performance en vertalen cijfers naar échte impact. Dat doen we met een team van mensen die goesting hebben om bij te leren, passie hebben voor digitale marketing, initiatief nemen en elkaar scherp houden zonder in te boeten op een gezonde work-life balance.

**Kan jij enkele eigenschappen afvinken?**
------------------------------------------

* Passie voor alles wat te maken heeft met digital marketing
* Performance marketing, het optimaliseren van customer journey en marketing automation klinken je bekend in de oren
* je hebt zelf een business-mindset en hebt zin om de business van onze klanten te laten groeien
* Data, technologie en de nieuwste digitale ontwikkelingen, daar word je gelukkig van
* Je staat open voor AI in je dagelijkse werk en gebruikt het om processen te versnellen, taken te automatiseren en efficiënter te werken
* Je daagt jezelf graag uit en blijft je kennis verbreden, ook buiten je eigen vakgebied
* Zin om je weg te zoeken in platformen zoals Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, TikTok, ChatGPT Ads, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, MailChimp, WordPress, etc.
* Een goeie pen is een bonus
* Je bent een teamplayer, maar ook alleen sta jij je mannetje/vrouwtje
* Je bent klantgericht
* Je overtuigt hen van je ideeën en visie, en volgt je werk op de juiste manier op
* Je spreekt Nederlands en woont in België

**Wat kan je verwachten?**
--------------------------

Geen micromanagement of vaste recepten. Wel vertrouwen, ownership en ruimte om impact te maken.

* Een competitief loonpakket, afgestemd op je ervaring
* Je zult professioneel groeien. We werken met je samen om de juiste ontwikkeling keuzes te maken voor je carrière. De vaardigheden die je opdoet, zullen je helpen om het meeste uit je tijd bij ons te halen en je in de toekomst beter te profileren.
* Vanaf de eerste dag maak je een verschil. We zetten je in op stimulerende projecten en als je een goed idee hebt, helpen we je graag om dat uit te werken.
* Flexibele werkuren en een thuiswerkdag
* Ruimte om te experimenteren met AI en nieuwe tools, en kennissessies waar we delen wat werkt
* Je maakt deel uit van een cultuur waar je trots op kunt zijn. We zijn vriendelijk en inclusief – dat is wat ons uniek maakt. Dus we ondersteunen en helpen je vanaf het moment dat je bij ons komt werken.
* Een hecht team waar vertrouwen, flexibiliteit en respect centraal staan
  

Twijfel je of je voldoende punten kan afvinken? Geen paniek, cultuur en attitude zijn voor ons minstens even belangrijk. Onze cultuur is één van onze grootste troeven. We investeren in mensen, niet alleen in resultaten.

job.title: Creative Marketing Project Coordinator @ CapsLock (Werk van thuis, BE)
job.description:
**CapsLock** is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At **CapsLock**, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

**﻿Role overview**

Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly.

You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow.

If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process.

**Responsibilities**

**Task & Pipeline Management**

* Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system).
* Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member
* Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch
* Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage

**Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up**

* Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers
* Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline
* Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them
* Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed

**Quality Control**

* Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications
* Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live
* Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context
* Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals

**Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned
* Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools
* Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

**Process Improvement & AI**

* Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow
* Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy
* Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes

**Creative Collaboration**

* Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas
* Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks
* Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time

  
Requirements:  
  

**Must-Have Skills**

* Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking
* Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks
* Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly
* Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy
* Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content

**Technical Skills**

* 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management
* Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello
* Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work
* Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus
* Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

**Soft Skills**

* Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems
* Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines
* Clear, professional communicator
* Adaptable to shifting priorities in a fast-paced team
* Curious, with the initiative to improve processes and contribute ideas

**What we offer**

* **Remote Work -** We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
* **Paid vacations** - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge
* **Unlimited Sick Days** - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
* **Ongoing Learning** - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
* **Home Office** -We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
* **Physical Well–Being** - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
* **Fun Stuff** - There is never a shortage of fun stuff

job.title: Brand Category Manager Cat @ Edgard & Cooper (Kortrijk, VLG, BE)
job.description:
**Brand Category Manager Cat**
------------------------------

Belgium, Kortrijk

#### **Our mission**

In 2016, our founders wanted to feed their dogs - named Edgard and Cooper - pet food they could feel good about. The kind of food that was as good for the planet as it was for their pets. But when they couldn't find this, they decided to make their own. Now, 10 years later, our pack has over 200 employees and we are beyond proud to be part of the B Corp movement.

Want to find out more about us? Click HERE

#### **What type of breed are we looking for?**

Ever been ignored by a cat? The slow blink, the turned back, the untouched bowl? Then you already know the toughest consumer on the planet. Now we’d like you to win them over. Across Europe.

As **EU Brand Category Manager Cat**, you own the full Cat category and drive its long term strategy and growth. You turn consumer insights, market trends and product performance into a clear vision and growth plans people can actually act on. You grow existing ranges, develop new innovations, shape how the brand shows up across markets, and make sure your knowledge and best practices get shared across teams.

#### **What is in your bowl?**

* **Growth vision:** build a 3 to 5 year growth vision for Cat, define and execute the strategy in line with our brand positioning and local market needs, and turn it into annual plans for the local business planning cycle.
* **Portfolio & cost:** own the Cat portfolio (innovation, renovation, activation), track performance against growth expectations, step in with corrective actions, and set priorities: must win segments, hero SKUs and cost optimisations.
* **Brand & product foundations:** use consumer and shopper insights to shape concepts and category direction, define messaging, claims and positioning for launches and core ranges, manage the artwork process, and partner with Marketing & Creative for consistent storytelling.
* **Go to market:** lead the global launch framework and 4P strategy with Markets Excellence (you own the global product and price proposition), align with commercial and creative teams on strong launch plans, engage with priority external customers, and equip local teams to launch in line with strategy and brand principles.
* **Lead & share:** lead and coach the Cat category team, be the Cat voice of the pack across the organisation, drive knowledge sharing across markets, and help build a strong team culture. (Yes, even the dog people will learn something.)

#### **What skills & tricks should you bring?**

* 6+ years in Marketing Strategy or portfolio roles
* Experience across multiple markets or regions
* Proven success launching and scaling innovations
* A track record in portfolio management and lifecycle planning
* Strong analytical skills, balanced with persuasive storytelling
* Understanding of category growth models, led by consumer insights and focused on product driven brand growth
* Proven ability to drive decisions with multiple stakeholders. Basically herding cats. Fitting, right?

Not sure if you tick all the boxes but our role truly excites you? Don’t let our job description hold you back, get applying!

#### **The Money Bits**

At Edgard & Cooper, we want work to feel as good as a belly rub. That’s why we offer:

* **Pay:** See Pay Transparency below
* **Benefits:** Meal vouchers, eco vouchers, hospitalisation insurance, cafeteria plan, 32 holidays plus the option to take an extra month off (unpaid) to recharge.
* **Pet-friendly culture:** Everyday is bring-your-pet-to-work day and pet food for your furry friend.
* **Be more dog**: Life is too short for rubbish work environments so get ready for fun team activities and a paid volunteering day.
* **Flexibility**: Option to work from home, plus one month per year to work from wherever makes you happiest.
* **Wellbeing and growth:** Gym access at Cottonpark, plus access to the wellbeing program and learning opportunities.

**Pay transparency**

We believe in being open about pay from the start. Every role has a salary range based on what the role involves and the Belgianmarket.

For this full-time role, the gross monthly base salary range is€5450 - €7500.

Every role comes with a bonus scheme, because when we do well together, there’s more to celebrate.

Where you land within the range depends on the experience, skills and capabilities you bring to the role. We apply the same principles consistently across candidates and consider internal equity.

#### **Hiring Process ️‍️**

* Intro call with Hannelore, Talent Acquisition Specialist (30’)
* Competency based interview (45’)
* Case study with Panel (90')

**Equal opportunities**

We believe the strength of a Pack comes from its diversity. We strive to create an environment where every person feels valued and empowered. So no matter who you are, where you come from, what you believe in or what your dreams are, we welcome you and look forward to receiving your application. If your circumstances require any special arrangements at any stage of our interview process, please let us know.

**Accessibility:** Our HQ office and satellite sites are wheelchair accessible.

job.title: Brand Manager (all genders)(EN) @ Contabo (Remote)
job.description:
YOUR CREATIVE FIELD
  
  
We are looking for a
**full-time, permanent Brand Manager**
(all genders)
**to start as soon as possible**
. We live remote-first within
**Germany**
, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.
  
  
As our new Brand Manager, you'll have responsibility of one of the most impactful projects currently running at Contabo: our brand. With 250,000+ customers worldwide and a strong reputation in developer and infrastructure communities, we're now transitioning from a VPS-focused positioning toward becoming Europe's AI Cloud Inference Provider.
  
  
The groundwork is done: strategy set, agency engaged, direction clear. What we need now is someone who takes ownership of the execution. That means running the agency relationship, driving the messaging architecture for both product identities, and making sure the rollout actually happens - across the website, product UI, API docs, email, paid, social. All of it and consistently.
  
  
You'll manage the branding agency end-to-end briefings, feedback rounds, milestone tracking, sign-offs and develop the messaging architecture and tone of voice for both product lines. That includes creating brand guidelines, design tokens, and all the rollout-ready assets that come with it. From there, you drive the actual rollout across every customer-facing touchpoint: website, product UI, API docs, email, paid media, social.
  
  
You brief and quality-control content output from internal and external contributors, keep the PR story pipeline moving together with our PR Manager, and set up brand tracking across Peec.ai, GA4, sentiment, and Share of Voice - reporting results directly to the Head of Creative Marketing and the CMO. As we continue to expand into EU, US, and LATAM markets, you're also the one making sure brand consistency and localization stay on track.
  
  
You'll report directly to the Head of Creative Marketing in the CMO organization and work closely with Product, Support, SEO/GAIO, and PR - without having direct authority over those teams. Strong stakeholder management is therefore a core part of making this work.
  
  
WHAT CONVINCES US
  
  
Your personality, paired with:
  
  
Must have:
  
  

* Proven experience developing brand strategy and identity - verbal and visual - from brief through to delivery
* Track record managing external agency relationships end-to-end (briefings, feedback rounds, sign-offs)
* Real familiarity with B2B / B2C tech audiences, particularly developers and infrastructure engineers - not surface-level, but you know how they think and what they dismiss immediately
* Project management across cross-functional teams: milestone tracking, stakeholder alignment, the coordination that doesn't show up in the final deck but determines whether the final deck ever gets implemented
* 5+ years in brand management or brand strategy, with meaningful time in B2B tech, SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or developer-focused products
* English C1/C2 (working language) and German B2+, other EU languages are a plus

Should have:
  
  

* Experience with brand tracking and measurement – sentiment, Share of Voice, brand recall surveys; you've used data to make a concrete decision, not just reported it
* Hands-on with tools like Peec.ai or Brand24, GA4, Figma, Confluence/Jira, and at least one CMS
* AI usage fluency

Nice to have:
  
  

* SEO and content strategy fundamentals; understanding of GAIO/LLM visibility is a real advantage here
* Experience in a PE-backed or VC-backed environment where ownership is high and process guardrails are limited
* Spanish or Portuguese

We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.
  
  
AWESOME PROSPECTS
  
  
At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
  
  
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.
  
  
Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
* Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
* Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
* Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
* Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
* Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
* Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
* Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
* Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
* Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
* Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget

HOW TO REACH US
  
  
If you have any questions, you can reach out to Lisa by email at lisa.bretzel@contabo.de.
  
  
**ABOUT US**
**Contabo - High-quality Cloud Hosting Made in Germany!**
As a leading infrastructure service provider in the field of cloud instances and dedicated servers, we have stood for first-class quality, reliability and favorable prices since our foundation in Munich in 2003. Meanwhile, more than 300,000 customers in over 190 countries trust our services.
  
  
We specialize in providing German quality to users worldwide, focusing on the stability and security of our data centers, the optimization of internal processes, and excellent customer support.
  
  
Become a part of our future-oriented company, which plays a significant role in the development of digital cloud hosting, and support us with your ideas and commitment.

Gemeinsam Großes bewegen bedeutet, jeden Tag Geschichte zu schreiben.
  
  
Herzlich willkommen bei AbbVie! Als Teil eines internationalen Unternehmens mit ca. 50.000 Mitarbeitern weltweit und rund 3.000 Mitarbeitern in Deutschland hast du die Möglichkeit, eng mit uns zusammenzuarbeiten, um die gesundheitlichen Herausforderungen von morgen zu meistern. Du brennst für die Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung innovativer Marketingstrategien im Healthcare-Bereich? Du möchtest als Brand Manager aktiv dazu beitragen, die Wahrnehmung und Positionierung unserer Marken zu stärken und damit einen spürbaren Beitrag zur Verbesserung der Lebensqualität von Patienten weltweit leisten? Wenn du eine Leidenschaft für Markenführung und Health Marketing hast – dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
  
  
**Was die Aufgabe als Brand Manager\*in mit sich bringt:**
Du bist leidenschaftlich im Marketing und möchtest die Pharmabranche aktiv mitgestalten? Innovationen, cross-funktionale Projekte und der Austausch mit internationalen Expert:innen motivieren dich? Dann werde Teil unseres Brand Management Teams! Bei uns erwarten dich spannende Aufgaben mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Entwickle wegweisende Produktkampagnen, bring frischen Wind in die Kommunikation und trage direkt zur Weiterentwicklung der Gesundheitsbranche bei. Arbeite mit inspirierenden Kolleg:innen, gestalte die Customer Experience neu und setze Meilensteine im Pharma-Marketing!
  
  
Wir rekrutieren momentan nicht aktiv für diese Position. Wir bauen gerade ein Netzwerk von außergewöhnlichen Persönlichkeiten auf, die über die für zukünftige Stellen erforderlichen Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen verfügen. Durch das Einreichen Ihrer Bewerbung für diese Ausschreibung wirst Du in unsere Talent-Pipeline aufgenommen und könntest zu einem unverbindlichen Gespräch mit unserem Talent Acquisition Team eingeladen werden.
  
  
Stell dein Know-how unter Beweis und werde Teil unseres Teams!
  
  
Stellenbeschreibung
  
  
**Konkret Bedeutet Das**

* Strategische Konzeption von Produktkampagnen und cross-funktionalen Projekten einschließlich der Umsetzung aller relevanter Milestones im Brand Management Team einer unserer Business Units - Immunology, Neuroscience, Oncology, Specialty Care, Aesthetics.

* Ausbau des Multi-Channel-Ecosystems und segmentspezifischer Kommunikation für eine zukunftsorientierte Kommunikation mit unseren Kunden und kontinuierliche Verbesserung zur Steigerung der Customer Experience
* Enger Austausch mit den Außendienst-Teams und externen Stakeholdern, um die neuesten Tendenzen und Anforderungen des Markts zu erfassen
* Analyse und Monitoring der Markt- und Wettbewerbersituation und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen
* Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung mit den Kollegen des globalen Teams bzgl. Strategien und taktischer Umsetzung

Qualifikationen
  
  
**So Machst Du Den Unterschied**

* Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Universitäts- oder FH-Studium, idealerweise im Bereich Marketing, Pharma- oder in der Gesundheitsbranche
* Berufserfahrung im Bereich Marketing, bevorzugt in der Gesundheitsbranche

* Fähigkeit, innovative Projekte eigenständig zu konzipieren und strukturiert voranzutreiben
* Ausgeprägte kommunikative Fähigkeiten
* Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse
* Strategische und analytische-konzeptionelle Denkweise

**Wie Wir Gemeinsam Großes Bewegen**

* mit einer offenen Unternehmenskultur

* mit einem intensiven Onboarding durch einen Mentor

* mit vielfältigen Karrieremöglichkeiten in einer internationalen Organisation
* mit hochkarätigen, attraktiven Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Bring frischen Wind in unser Team – und deine Karriere
  
  
Bei AbbVie zählt dein individueller Beitrag – helfe uns, gemeinsam Großes zu bewegen. Sei ein Teil von unserem Erfolg und wachse mit uns – und wachse über dich hinaus! * Mitgestaltung der Markenführung sowie Unterstützung bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Markenstrategien, Produktinnovationen und Verpackungskonzepten
* Planung und Umsetzung zielgruppenspezifischer Marketing- und Kommunikationsmaßnahmen für B2B- und B2C-Kanäle einschließlich Social Media
* Unterstützung bei der Steuerung der Marke in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Vertriebskanälen sowie Koordination externer Agenturen und Dienstleister
* Entwicklung, Gestaltung und Verwaltung von Werbemitteln sowie Sicherstellung eines einheitlichen Markenauftritts
* Durchführung von Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Potenzialanalysen sowie qualitative und quantitative Auswertung der Marketingaktivitäten
* Konzeption und Umsetzung von Messen, Kundenveranstaltungen und Lifestyle-Events sowie Repräsentation unserer Italian Brands bei nationalen und internationalen Geschäftspartnern

**WAS DICH AUSMACHT:**

* Du überzeugst mit deiner Kreativität, deinem Innovationsgeist und einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität und hast Freude daran, neue Ideen aktiv umzusetzen.
* Du bist kommunikationsstark, denkst analytisch und verbindest strategisches Denken mit einer strukturierten und lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise.
* Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Marken, Trends und Social Media und bringst idealerweise Kenntnisse im strategischen und operativen Marketing mit.
* Du verfügst idealerweise über ein abgeschlossenes betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Marketing oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie erste Berufserfahrung im Marketing, vorzugsweise in der Getränkebranche.
* Du begeisterst dich für das Thema Wein und bist motiviert, dein Wissen über Weine und die Weinbranche kontinuierlich zu erweitern.
* Du verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und bewegst dich sicher in einem internationalen Umfeld.

**WARUM MBG? MEHR ALS NUR EIN JOB!**

* 30 Tage Urlaub
* Hochwertiges Arbeitsequipment mit Laptop und aktuellem iPhone sowie moderne, klimatisierte und hochwertig ausgestattete Büroräume
* Strukturiertes Onboarding mit Einblicken in alle Unternehmensbereiche sowie individuelle Weiterbildungs-und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
* Haustrunk, attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte sowie hauseigenes Fitnessstudio, Spa-Bereich und vielfältige Gesundheitsangebote
* Legendäre Team-Events, Konzert- und Festivalbesuche sowie Highlights wie unsere SALITOS Beach Party und unsere MBG-Weihnachtsfeier
* Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge für deine finanzielle Zukunft

**Über uns**
Seit 30 Jahren stehen wir für einzigartige und innovative Marken sowie höchste Qualitätsstandards in der nationalen und internationalen Getränkebranche. Zum Portfolio gehören u.a. effect®, SALITOS, SCAVI & RAY, GOLDBERG & Sons und 9 MILE Vodka.
  
  
So vielfältig wie unsere Marken, sind Deine Karrierechancen bei uns. Derzeit beschäftigt die MBG Group rund 250 Mitarbeiter\*innen im Headoffice in Paderborn sowie in ganz Deutschland.
  
  
Wir wachsen stetig und suchen Menschen, die den Erfolg unserer Marken mitgestalten.
